# cato_cloud_interconnect_site (Resource)

Manages Cloud Interconnect site metadata. Physical connections are managed separately; deletion is refused while any connection exists. Import using its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Registers Cato site metadata; physical connections use their own resource.
resource "cato_cloud_interconnect_site" "example" {
  name      = "Development interconnect"
  site_type = "BRANCH"
  # description = "Terraform managed Cloud Interconnect site"
  site_location = {
    country_code = "GB"
    timezone     = "Europe/London"
    # city       = "London"
    # state_code = ""
    # address    = "Site address"
  }
}

# Remove separately managed physical connections before destroying this site.
# terraform import cato_cloud_interconnect_site.example 12345
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name
- `site_location` (Attributes) Site location (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--site_location))
- `site_type` (String) Site type

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Removing the value clears it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID

<a id="nestedatt--site_location"></a>
### Nested Schema for `site_location`

Required:

- `country_code` (String) Country code
- `timezone` (String) Timezone

Optional:

- `address` (String) Address. Omission uses the API default or current value.
- `city` (String) City. Omission uses the API default or current value.
- `state_code` (String) State code. Omission uses the API default or current value.
